shell_commands:
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,260p' .lore/dod.md
printf '\\n--- status ---\\n'
git status --short --branch
printf '\\n--- package files ---\\n'
rg --files | sed -n '1,160p'
printf '\\n--- registry ---\\n'
sed -n '1,260p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts
printf '\\n--- registry test ---\\n'
sed -n '1,240p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git branch --show-current
sed -n '1,260p' specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md
cat package.json | sed -n '1,120p'
rg -n \"inputSchema|extra|passthrough|validated by\" specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git diff --check
git diff --stat
git diff -- src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md .lore/dod.md'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git add .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts && git commit -m "test tools preserve extra input properties"'
